subject: 110 dogs started before you
preview_text: You're now part of a pack that's changing how we feed our best friends. Here's what they found.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, a golden retriever named Gus hit 15% weight loss in exactly 8 weeks. His owner, Sarah, sent us a photo of him running on the beach—something he couldn't do last summer. She said, I almost gave up, but the app made it simple. Gus is one of 110 dogs now on a healthier path. You're not just tracking calories. You're part of a pack that's doing this differently.

Most people think weight loss for dogs is about starving them or buying expensive vet food. It's not. It's about small, smart swaps that add up. Our community has proven that together—with 110 dogs averaging 15% weight loss in 8 weeks. You're not alone in this. Every time you log a meal or check a milestone, you're joining a movement of dog parents who figured out the nutrition puzzle without the guilt.

Here's the feature that ties it all together: your progress tracker. It's not just a chart—it's your dog's story. Every milestone you hit adds to our collective win. Open the app and look at your timeline. See how far you've come. Then check the community feed to see Gus's before and after. That's what belonging looks like.

Open PupShape now and check your dog's next milestone. One tap. You'll see your place in the pack. P.S. Gus's owner said the best part was the relief of knowing she was finally doing right by him. That feeling is waiting for you.
cta_text: Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan
